subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw permanently publish `withSessionTranscriptIndexedWriteLock` and its three indexed persistence facts as a generic Plugin SDK contract for plugins beyond Codex and Copilot?
rationale: This is an additive external SDK surface with long-lived compatibility cost; tests can validate behavior but cannot determine whether the public contract should exist or remain owner-local.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Approve the three typed indexed reads as generic transcript capabilities, then require final-head runtime proof before normal merge review.

options.title: Keep indexed facts owner-local
options.body: Do not expand the public SDK for two current mirrors; redesign the optimization behind a bounded internal or bundled-plugin seam.

recommendation.title: Keep indexed facts owner-local
recommendation.body: Do not expand the public SDK for two current mirrors; redesign the optimization behind a bounded internal or bundled-plugin seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged transcript-generation foundation and this follow-up, making them the strongest available technical routing candidate; final API direction still needs a maintainer decision.
